events.title: Tupac Shakur: 30 Years On
events.blurb: Remembering the influential rapper Tupac Shakur, who tragically passed away on September 13, 1996, at the age of 25.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years since we lost a legend. Tupac Shakur's impact on music and culture remains as powerful as ever. Which track still hits hardest for you?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix: 56 Years Since We Lost a Legend
events.blurb: Remembering guitar icon Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: 56 years since the world lost Jimi Hendrix. His innovative guitar work continues to inspire generations. What's your go-to Hendrix riff?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic album 'Abbey Road' was released in the UK on September 26, 1969, featuring timeless tracks and that legendary cover.

angles.name: Iconic Album Cover
angles.copy: That zebra crossing, those suits, those songs! The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' is 57 today. What's your favourite track from this masterpiece?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde Turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' frontwoman and rock icon Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock Goddess Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher Turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis and Beady Eye frontman, the one and only Liam Gallagher, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Mad Fer It Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the voice of a generation, Liam Gallagher! What's your favourite Oasis anthem or solo track from the man himself?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Album Turns 55
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic solo album 'Imagine', featuring the timeless title track, was released in the UK on October 8, 1971.

angles.name: Imagine The Impact
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. The album and its message are as relevant as ever. What does 'Imagine' mean to you?

events.title: The First iPod Turns 25
events.blurb: Apple launched the original iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music and putting '1,000 songs in your pocket'.

angles.name: Pocket Full Of Tunes
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? The original iPod is 25 today! It changed everything for music lovers. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken Not Stirred
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme tunes, what's your favourite Bond moment or song?

events.title: John Lennon Would Have Been 86
events.blurb: Remembering the life and enduring legacy of The Beatles' co-founder, John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the incredible life and music of John Lennon. What's your favourite Lennon lyric or song?

events.title: John Cleese Turns 87
events.blurb: Comedy legend and Monty Python star John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! What's your favourite Monty Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking double album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Wonders
angles.copy: 58 years of the 'White Album'! A sprawling, diverse masterpiece from The Beatles. Which track from the double LP is essential listening for you?

events.title: Freddie Mercury: 35 Years On
events.blurb: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who passed away on November 24, 1991, leaving behind an unparalleled musical legacy.

angles.name: Legendary Frontman
angles.copy: 35 years since we lost the magnificent Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential album 'Rubber Soul' in the UK on December 3, 1965, marking a significant shift in their sound.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Revolution
angles.copy: 61 years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul', an album that pushed boundaries. What's your favourite track from this classic?
